lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 2 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 ≤ α →
        0 < β →
          α ≤ β →
            (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
              ∀ (x y : E),
                ‖y - (2 / (α + β)) • gradient f y - (x - (2 / (α + β)) • gradient f x)‖ ≤ (β - α) / (α + β) * ‖y - x‖ ∧
                  ∀ (h : ℝ), (β - α) / (α + β) ≤ max |1 - h * α| |1 - h * β|
approved_definition_context: gradient f x is the Riesz vector of the Frechet derivative; with the stated C2 premise it is the actual gradient.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ a f means the global segment inequality f(s*x+t*y) <= s*f(x)+t*f(y)-(a/2)*s*t*norm(x-y)^2 for s,t>=0 and s+t=1; the parameter a may be any real number.
ContDiff R 2 f means f is twice continuously Frechet differentiable.
